message.content:
Some critics included Martin Luther, who attacked heliocentrism in a sermon.
Cardinal Bellarmine, as a later opponent, insisted that its heliocentrism should not be taught as truth.
Tycho Brahe also challenged parts of the model while keeping Earth near the center.
Did Luther call Copernicus a new astronomer whose ideas needed refutation?
Which later opponent urged that heliocentrism be treated as a mathematical convenience?
How did Brahe combine Ptolemaic motion with a geocentric compromise?
How boldly Copernicus overturned ancient astronomy!
What a storm his book created among religious and scholarly leaders!
How complex the debate became over the place of Earth!
